candidats.description: Compteur prépayé pour courant triphasé de Bauer Electronic. Photographié à Hard, dans le Vorarlberg, en Autriche. Après paiement, un code est émis sur une machine, avec lequel le compteur électrique est alors activé pour une quantité d'énergie payée.

candidats.description: This is a smart electricity meter in an apartment in the UK. It is a prepayment meter that can be topped up using a plastic key or with a mobile phone app. The key slot is on the underside of the device, and so is not visible on the photograph. The device was installed in 2023.
categories: Electricity meters with liquid crystal displays

candidats.description: Australia is working to improve energy efficiency and distribution in the Marshall Islands. Australian aid is funding prepay meters to assist customers with budgeting their electricity usage, an energy specialist to work with the Ministry of Resources and Development, and volunteers to build staff skills and improve operations at the Marshall Islands’ utilities companies. Photo: Erin Magee, AusAID For a high resolution copy of this photo, please contact photolibrary@ausaid.gov.au
